security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: A desktop client for MS SQL Server, AWS Athena, MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite
bundle.longDescription: SQL Explorer connects to MS SQL Server, AWS Athena, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite. It shows the objects of each server in a tree, runs statements in tabs, and exports the results.
